definition: Only explicit standing-passenger counts are published, with their operator/configuration, minimum or density qualification. Driver, wheelchair spaces and folding seats are not standing places. Different layout maxima are not automatically additive. Unknown counts are omitted, never replaced by zero or inferred as total minus seats.
